title: 历史文献转录OCR系统的实体感知评估
summary: 该研究提出以实体级分析补充传统OCR评估指标，基于Berrutti档案175份文档及5209个实体标注，比较序列识别OCR、OCR专用视觉语言模型与通用视觉语言模型。结果显示OCR系统排名随评估标准变化，Qwen 3.6实体覆盖率最高，部分系统在容忍小误差后恢复显著，说明聚合转录指标不足以全面刻画OCR质量。
summary_en: This work proposes entity-level analysis as a complement to standard OCR metrics, using 175 Berrutti Archive documents with 5,209 annotated entity mentions to compare sequence-recognition OCR, OCR-specialized VLMs, and general-purpose VLMs. OCR rankings shift with the evaluation criterion: Qwen 3.6 achieves the highest entity coverage, and several systems recover substantially under relaxed matching, showing aggregate transcription metrics alone cannot fully characterize OCR quality.
